blogs.title: Few good registry cleaners
blogs.content:
If you are in search of a “Free registry cleaners” then you may come across thousands of them readily available over internet, but only few of them can be trusted and can be tried without risking your computer. Here, we are going to state you few good registry cleaner programs.
First of all, a question raises do we really need any registry cleaner? And the answer is Yes, because during the long term use of Windows we keep on installing and uninstalling multiple programs. Because of this, registry gets continuously filled by numerous useless keys. This overstuffing of registry slows down the computer system and creates multiple problems in the long run.
So to clean up your registry we recommend the following registry cleaners, however in no specific order.

blogs.title: What is a .Dat file in windows?
blogs.content:
Sometimes you might have received an email containing an attachment with .Dat extension, and then you must have questioned yourself that “What is .Dat file”. Further you might have asked that how to excess this particular file. So, let’s have a look at solution to those frequent doubts.
The very first thing that .Dat file indicates is that it contains some random data and it is not designed to be used by some specific applications. It means unlike the case of some frequently used file, let’s say seeing an XLS file one can easily say that it should be opened by Microsoft Excel, but in case of .Dat file you yourself have to decide that with which program you must open that file. It can be different programs at different times.

blogs.title: How to convert a PDF to word?

blogs.title: Windows explorer has stopped working?
blogs.title_hi: विंडोज एक्सप्लोरर ने काम करना बंद कर दिया है?
blogs.content:
Since the beginning of the windows era there have been few windows’ errors which manage to show their existence every now and then. A very common among them that would come into your mind would be the critical recovery error shown by windows, however if you go for searching about it in detail then you would land among numerous entries. Similarly, another very common error is "Windows explorer has stopped working".
This one is very frequent on windows 7 enabled PC. The reason for its recurrent occurrence is that they have multiple causes. It’s not some single issue which brings such error, hence it’s hard to fix. Here, we will list out few steps to be used in order to fix such errors.

blogs.title: Does Your Computer Keep Freezing Too?
blogs.title_hi: क्या आपका कंप्यूटर बहुत धीमा रहता है?
blogs.content:
Is your computer freezing too?

If you are in search of an answer to “Why does my computer keep freezing” then simply sit back and relax; as your problem is fixable. It is not a serious issue. Most often freezing of your computer system indicates that something is going wrong inside, and it demands fixing before it turns out into a big problem. Although freezing is a very common phenomenon which must have been experienced by most of the computer users, it shouldn’t be overlooked. The sooner you sort out the issue, the better it will prove for your system. So from next time whenever your computer system freezes, need not to panic as you know it can be easily resolved.

blogs.title: Modern Computer Antivirus
blogs.content:
At present every computer user is facing problem of his system being affected by the malware programs.
Malware is term which collectively refers to malicious programs like virus, Trojans, worms and spyware
programs. Once your computer has been affected an unauthorized person can track your personnel works,
modify the contents of your personnel document and use your computer to attack other computers. Antivirus
softwares are the programs which help in building a shield which protects your computer system from being
affected by the malware programs.
